newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Skanska to redeem 12.43 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Skanska to redeem 12.43 mln shares.

text.p: Swedish construction company Skanska said on Thursday it would redeem a total of 12,428,814 shares, including 12,394,484 B series shares and 34,330 A series shares.
Skanska said in May it intended to redeem one in every 10 shares at 400 crowns each, totalling five billion crowns.
The application period for the voluntary redemption programme was now over, Skanska said in a statement.
Owners had applied for redemption of 98.7 percent of all shares eligible, 9.9 percent of the total number of shares and 6.1 percent of votes in the company.
Payment for redeemed shares was expected around August 27, it said. The actual process needs approval from an August 4 extraordinary shareholders' meeting.
